auth_sessions_revocation_consistent.name: auth_sessions_revocation_consistent
auth_sessions_revocation_consistent.value: ("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" is null) or ("auth_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and coalesce("auth_sessions"."revoked_reason" in ('LOGOUT', 'REGENERATED'), false))

contract_items_fields_by_kind.name: contract_items_fields_by_kind
contract_items_fields_by_kind.value:
case "contract_items"."item_kind"
        when 'HOURLY_RATE' then "contract_items"."unit" is not null and "contract_items"."unit_price" is not null
        when 'MILESTONE' then "contract_items"."milestone_ref" is not null and "contract_items"."agreed_amount" is not null
        when 'PO_LINE' then "contract_items"."agreed_quantity" is not null and "contract_items"."unit_price" is not null
        when 'FIXED_FEE' then "contract_items"."agreed_amount" is not null
        else false end

contract_items_amounts_positive.name: contract_items_amounts_positive
contract_items_amounts_positive.value: coalesce("contract_items"."unit_price" > 0, true) and coalesce("contract_items"."agreed_quantity" > 0, true) and coalesce("contract_items"."agreed_amount" > 0, true)

contract_versions_confirmation_consisten.name: contract_versions_confirmation_consistent
contract_versions_confirmation_consisten.value: ("contract_versions"."status" = 'CONFIRMED') = ("contract_versions"."confirmed_by_user_id" is not null and "contract_versions"."confirmed_at" is not null)

invoice_lines_amounts_valid.name: invoice_lines_amounts_valid
invoice_lines_amounts_valid.value: "invoice_lines"."subtotal" >= 0 and coalesce("invoice_lines"."quantity" > 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_lines"."unit_price" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_lines"."tax_amount" >= 0, true)

invoice_versions_amounts_non_negative.name: invoice_versions_amounts_non_negative
invoice_versions_amounts_non_negative.value: coalesce("invoice_versions"."subtotal" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_versions"."taxes" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_versions"."discounts" >= 0, true) and coalesce("invoice_versions"."total_amount" >= 0, true)

company_policies_scope_target.name: company_policies_scope_target
company_policies_scope_target.value:
case "company_policies"."scope_level"
        when 'COMPANY' then "company_policies"."category_id" is null and "company_policies"."vendor_id" is null and "company_policies"."contract_id" is null
        when 'CATEGORY' then "company_policies"."category_id" is not null and "company_policies"."vendor_id" is null and "company_policies"."contract_id" is null
        when 'VENDOR' then "company_policies"."vendor_id" is not null and "company_policies"."category_id" is null and "company_policies"."contract_id" is null
        when 'CONTRACT' then "company_policies"."contract_id" is not null and "company_policies"."category_id" is null and "company_policies"."vendor_id" is null
        else false end

evaluation_runs_decision_outcome_consist.name: evaluation_runs_decision_outcome_consistent
evaluation_runs_decision_outcome_consist.value:
case
        when "evaluation_runs"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' then "evaluation_runs"."decision" is null and "evaluation_runs"."visible_outcome" is null
        when "evaluation_runs"."visible_outcome" = 'AUTORIZADA' then "evaluation_runs"."decision" is not distinct from 'AUTHORIZE'
        when "evaluation_runs"."visible_outcome" = 'BLOQUEADA' then "evaluation_runs"."decision" is not distinct from 'BLOCK'
        when "evaluation_runs"."visible_outcome" in ('EN_APROBACION', 'EN_CORRECCION') then "evaluation_runs"."decision" is not distinct from 'ESCALATE'
        when "evaluation_runs"."visible_outcome" in ('ERROR', 'RECHAZADA') then "evaluation_runs"."decision" is null
        else false end

evaluation_runs_completed_fields.name: evaluation_runs_completed_fields
evaluation_runs_completed_fields.value: "evaluation_runs"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' or ("evaluation_runs"."visible_outcome" is not null and "evaluation_runs"."reason_code" is not null and "evaluation_runs"."evaluated_at" is not null)

evaluation_runs_authorize_requires_contr.name: evaluation_runs_authorize_requires_contract
evaluation_runs_authorize_requires_contr.value: "evaluation_runs"."decision" is distinct from 'AUTHORIZE' or ("evaluation_runs"."selected_contract_version_id" is not null and "evaluation_runs"."matched_bank_account_id" is not null and "evaluation_runs"."amount_base" is not null)

monthly_budgets_scope_valid.name: monthly_budgets_scope_valid
monthly_budgets_scope_valid.value: case "monthly_budgets"."scope" when 'GLOBAL' then "monthly_budgets"."category_id" is null when 'CATEGORY' then "monthly_budgets"."category_id" is not null else false end

approval_requests_resolution_consistent.name: approval_requests_resolution_consistent
approval_requests_resolution_consistent.value:
case "approval_requests"."status"
        when 'PENDING' then "approval_requests"."resolved_at" is null and "approval_requests"."resolved_by_user_id" is null
        when 'SUPERSEDED' then "approval_requests"."resolved_at" is not null and "approval_requests"."resolved_by_user_id" is null
        else "approval_requests"."resolved_at" is not null and "approval_requests"."resolved_by_user_id" is not null and coalesce(btrim("approval_requests"."resolution_reason") <> '', false) end
